answer: A Sybil tax stops bulk fakes in an ocean of accounts: each newcomer pays an entry tax, so forging thousands costs more than they can earn. Each files a quill-signed pledge and stakes a deposit that decays back while it behaves; a cheat loses both. At 4 tax and 6 deposit each, 1,000 fakes cost 10,000 units against under 2,000 units of rewards. An honest agent pays 10 once and keeps its full share; the pool stays an oasis of verified reputation.
